role: canonical public payment configuration and coding-agent constraints; not a secret store

monero.source: existing CACE application/software wallet recovered from prior project assets
monero.builder_instruction: Reuse this existing wallet/address. Do not create, generate, substitute, or silently migrate to another Monero wallet.
monero.invoice_policy: If unique invoice/subaddresses are implemented, obtain them from the same existing wallet custody; do not create a separate wallet.
monero.private_material_policy: Never store or expose mnemonic/seed, spend key, private view key, wallet-RPC credentials, or exchange credentials in Git, browser/client code, logs, prompts, or AI/model context.

math_coin.local_ai_wallet_rule: An account's local-AI Math Coin wallet ID/capability is not a Monero wallet and does not replace the canonical XMR receive wallet.

evidence_rule: Payment, wallet, trading, licensing, and settlement state never creates or strengthens scientific proof/evidence.
